Passionate about innovative technology? Your place is with us!

We create and license technology that powers the newest generation of smart edge devices and provide innovative silicon and software IP solutions for artificial intelligence, computer vision, audio processing, sensor fusion, 5G and satellite communication, and wireless connectivity. With more than 20 billion devices shipped, Ceva is making the future brighter for people all around the world. Join Ceva and let’s build the future of the smart edge together.

 

If you’re looking for a place that values your curiosity, passion, and desire to learn, if you’re seeking colleagues who are big thinkers eager to take on fresh challenges as a team, then Ceva is the place for you.

Trusted by top brands

Why us?

Professional Growth

If you want to take your professional experience to new heights, master new skills, become an expert on the latest technologies and make an impact through your work, come and grow with us.

Inspiring Environment

Surround yourself with highly motivated and passionate peers who are all working together towards the same goal. At Ceva, you will always be learning the most advanced technologies, tackling the complex challenges and improving in our consistently dynamic environment.

Wellbeing Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits, perks and enjoyment to ensure your wellbeing and invest in our people by offering competitive work-life benefits, equity, pension, health benefits, and career development opportunities.

Global and personal

We’re a truly global and collaborative company, working in all continents, yet still keeping a startup atmosphere at our offices, with a personal approach to all our peers.
